overview.about: The Little League World Series is the world championship of youth baseball for 10-to-12-year-olds, held every August in South Williamsport, Pennsylvania. Broadcast nationally in the US, it pairs teams from across America with international sides in a tournament famous for underdog stories and a big-league atmosphere. The 2026 series is on 19-30 August.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 Little League World Series runs 19-30 August in South Williamsport, Pennsylvania, the tournament's home since 1947. Regional champions from the United States meet international teams from around the world for the title.
